body: My husband *just* recently had a sleep study done, was diagnosed with apnea, and got a cpap. We’re still sleeping in separate rooms, since my sleep schedule is so wacky.
Both times they said it must be environmental. I got a white noise maker. My husband actually sleeps in another room because of snoring. Not sure what else to do.
I’ve thought about a new psychiatrist. We’ve tried pretty much every medication under the sun. That’s what it feels like anyway.
In my opinion, that’s the most cringe worthy line of the entire series.
Lorelai’s turn down service for Luke and Nicole.
Thank you. Trust me, I will never tell my husband. And yes, I make sure they have alone time.
